title: Rox: sales deal health and revenue insights in Teams
availability: Listed partner integration; no live tenant verification
overview: Microsoft documents Rox revenue intelligence inside Teams, including deal health, pipeline status, forecasts and actions on recommendations. This model stays within retrieving and presenting those insights rather than inventing discount or CRM-write operations.
published_facts: Rox revenue data is surfaced in Microsoft Teams.
The documented data includes deal health, pipeline status and revenue forecasts.
Rox agent activity is tracked through the Microsoft 365 admin-center observability dashboard.

sources.title: Ecosystem partner agents available in Agent 365 - Rox
sources.verification: Primary page and Rox section fetched and read directly.

a365_relationship: Direct: Microsoft explicitly describes the Rox Agent 365 integration.
intent: Retrieve deal health and pipeline forecasts and present relevant revenue insights to the sales team in Teams.
actors: Sales representative or manager and Rox agent; locally abstracted as Agent.
published_outcome: Documented access to pipeline insights in Teams; forecast accuracy and sales outcomes are not established by these tests.

actions.description: Access pipeline status and revenue forecasts.
Prepare the relevant revenue insight or recommendation.
Present the insight in the sales team's Teams workflow.

local_assumptions: The sequential dependency between datasets and presentation is a local simplified contract.
The runtime test adds review of the exact forecast summary before publishing it to an allowlisted conversation.
No CRM discount change, price approval or write-back permission is claimed from this source.
limitations: Structural admissibility does not prove forecast accuracy or recommendation usefulness.
Actual CRM row-level access and data freshness are not discovered.
Any concrete sales write-back action would need its own documented tool contract and policy.

runtime_model.source_fixture: Synthetic pipeline snapshot, no customer deal data.
